DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchiectasis.

I have noted your denial of systemic symptoms and the previous misdiagnosis of pyelonephritis; given your 11-year history of copious purulent sputum and recurrent bronchitis, the clinical picture strongly points to bronchiectasis. The sputum color and chronicity are classic for this condition, even in the absence of wheezing.
